reviews.body: thanks for the PR, I think the logic looks right but the tests need a few small tweaks
this looks good to me and I ran the integration tests on a copy of the branch within the repo

review_comments.body: could you please update this to work against python 3.8?

This mostly tests the fake, since the fake builds the environment from the kwarg it was passed. It also misses `allow_uv`, which the real `create_python_environment` sets. Could you mock `Environment._get_python_env_info` instead and assert both `name` and `allow_uv`?

comments.body:
Thanks for the review. Pushed a follow-up that addresses both points:

- The test no longer builds a `dict[...]` annotation at runtime, so it works on Python 3.8.
- It now mocks `Environment._get_python_env_info` instead of faking `create_python_environment`, so the real package manager selection runs. It asserts both `name` and `allow_uv` in the written manifest, for `uv` and `pip` across shiny/streamlit/fastapi.
- The `deploy quarto` test is back with the same approach: the real `create_python_environment` runs on top of the mocked `_get_python_env_info`, and the test asserts the package manager is `uv` and `allow_uv` is true on the environment that `deploy quarto` builds.
